in_sanskrit.name: रिध्वांश
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The word 'Ridhvansh' is derived from the Sanskrit words 'Ridh' (meaning 'to attain') and 'Vansh' (meaning 'lineage, descent, progeny'). Thus, the name Ridhvansh can be translated as 'One who attains a good lineage' or 'One who has a good descent'.

in_hindi.name: रिध्वांश
in_hindi.long_meaning: The name 'Ridhvansh' is also used in Hindi, and it translates to 'Vansh', which means 'lineage, descent, progeny'. Thus, the name Ridhvansh can be understood as 'One who has a good lineage' or 'One who comes from a noble family' in Hindi as well.

in_marathi.name: Ridhvansh
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Descendant of Ridhva
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ridhvansh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Ridhvansh is a Hindu name for boys that means 'descendant of Ridhva'. Ridhva is a Sanskrit name that means 'ruler', 'lord'. Therefore, Ridhvansh can be interpreted as 'descendant of the ruler'. This name is often given to a boy who is destined to rule or lead in some way.
